name: openmcad-native
description: Native dependencies for the OpenMCAD geometry and constraint-solver shims.
$comment-determinism: PLAN.md 5.2.3 and ADR-0011 make reproducible geometry a hard requirement, and the two levers
are the OCCT version and its build flags. Both are pinned here.
The tbb feature is deliberately NOT enabled. It brings Intel Threading Building Blocks into
OCCT and turns on internal parallelism, whose results can vary with scheduling. The plan is
explicit: disable parallel execution inside OCCT and enable it only where proven
deterministic. Turning it on later must come with the double-rebuild diff proving it changed
vtk is not enabled either. OCCT ships its own visualisation layer; ADR-0008 renders with
Direct3D 12 through our own pipeline, so linking a second one would be dead weight in the
installer and one more thing to licence-audit.
$comment-features: freetype: text rendering. Needed by the sketch text tool at P8-T02, and cheap to carry.
eigen3: required by planegcs (ADR-0006). MPL-2.0; its optional LGPL components are excluded
by the default feature set, which THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md records.
